lead: Western Gold Resources' expanded scoping study dominated, lifting the Gold Duke Production Target 62% to 1.11Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 59.7koz contained gold, a 30% increase on the September 2025 study, with an estimated A$72.9 million operating surplus at A$6,100/oz gold ahead of first ore.
subtitle: Gold drilling extends resources at multiple names, two halts pending capital raisings.
subject: WGR lifts Gold Duke target 62% to 1.11Mt for 59.7koz, A$72.9M surplus
watch_items: NXM: trading halt pending capital raising and Wallbrook MRE upgrade, resumes 21 September 2026 or on announcement, whichever first.
ENT: trading halt pending capital raising and board changes, resumes 21 September 2026 or on earlier announcement.
SLS: assays pending from 16 diamond and over 20 RC holes at Nanadie, plus an EIS co-funded 850m hole testing a newly identified conductive plate.
SNM: assays for holes 5 to 7 due October 2026 ahead of an updated Columbia MRE targeted November 2026.
LGM: combined Ni-Co-Sc estimate for NiCo Young expected October 2026.
PC2: drilling at the untested Southern Adit target planned to start late September 2026.
CZN: first assays from the 50-hole Chalice RC program expected within weeks, completion due November 2026.
day_in_brief: Resources and studies: Western Gold Resources' expanded scoping study lifted the Gold Duke Production Target 62% to 1.11Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 59.7koz contained gold (55.5koz recoverable at 93% metallurgical recovery), generating an estimated A$72.9 million operating surplus at A$6,100/oz gold. Legacy Minerals has engaged WSP Australia to fold scandium into an updated NiCo Young estimate alongside the existing 167.8Mt at 0.59% Ni and 0.06% Co Inferred Resource, due October 2026. Drilling and extensions: Sunstone's Nanadie diamond tails returned 52m @ 0.71% Cu, 0.13g/t Au from 406m outside the 40.4 million tonne resource, with DHEM identifying a 140m x 140m conductive plate now targeted by an 850m follow-up hole. Prospect Resources extended Nyungu Central beyond its 154.4Mt @ 0.42% Cu resource with 27m @ 0.69% Cu from 102m and 5.1m @ 0.99% Cu from 173m, while confirming a new discovery at Sharamba. Pilbara Gold's maiden Terra Prospect hits at Roe Hills included 46m @ 3.17g/t Au from 92m and 4m @ 9.91g/t Au from 144m incl. 1m @ 33.62g/t Au, over a mineralised trend open at depth and along strike. Southern Cross Gold's Columbia drilling extended stacked gold zones over 140m, with DDCO26-003 returning 48m @ 1.13g/t Au from 18.0m, ahead of holes 5 to 7 due in October and an updated MRE targeted for November 2026. New discoveries and targets: PC Gold identified a third high-grade domain at Spring Hill's Southern Adit, 20.35m @ 13.04g/t Au entirely outside the current resource, with drilling planned late September 2026. Corazon Mining began a 50-hole, ~7,500m RC program at Chalice Gold testing extensions to its 191,000oz resource within a 600,000 to 830,000oz exploration target. Taruga Minerals defined a new 500m gold-copper trend at Uaroo Ridge, headlined by 1.4g/t Au and 4.3% Cu at UARK042, while relinquishing peripheral tenements to focus on core prospects. Altair expanded its South Oko landholding by 29km2, lifting Oko Shear Contact strike exposure 30% to approximately 18km across a now 457km2 project. Corporate and funding: Nexus Minerals and Enterprise Metals both entered trading halts pending capital raisings, Nexus alongside an upgraded Wallbrook MRE and Enterprise alongside proposed board changes, both expected to resume normal trading by 21 September 2026 absent an earlier announcement. Santana Minerals will join the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ, approximately US$8.9 billion in net assets) at the close of trading on 18 September 2026. Administrative: Atomic Eagle reissued its Muntanga update solely to add Listing Rule 5.23 and 5.13 disclosures and a Competent Person sign-off, confirming no new exploration data.

summaries.heading: Expanded scoping study lifts Gold Duke production target 30%
summaries.body: Western Gold Resources' Expanded Scoping Study for Gold Duke lifts the Production Target 62% to 1.11Mt at 1.7g/t Au for 59.7koz contained gold, up 30% from the September 2025 study's 46.0koz. About 55.5koz is forecast recovered at 93% metallurgical recovery, with 82% of the target from Measured and Indicated resources. At A$6,100/oz gold, the project generates an estimated A$72.9 million operating surplus before capital, financing and tax, with the company now focused on completing the work required to reach first ore.

summaries.heading: Altair expands South Oko landholding along Oko Shear Contact
summaries.body: Altair has secured 29km2 of adjoining permits at South Oko, lifting its Oko Shear Contact strike exposure by 30% to approximately 18km. The Greater Oko Project now spans 457km2. Altair paid a US$175,000 signing fee for a 60-day due diligence period, with a US$1,075,000 completion payment to follow and an option exercisable for US$4,500,000 within 48 months. New targets are expected to be integrated into the current RC drilling program within three months.

summaries.heading: PC Gold finds third high-grade domain at Spring Hill
summaries.body: Channel sampling along the historical Southern Adit, 262m south of the Main Adit which produced 21,170oz at ~30g/t Au, has returned 20.35m @ 13.04g/t Au entirely outside the current Mineral Resource Estimate, with a best 1m channel result of 74.8g/t Au. LiDAR suggests a further 150m of strike toward the Main Adit and Middle Zone. The target is untested by drilling, with drilling planned to start late September 2026.

summaries.heading: New Nanadie diamond tails extend copper-gold well beyond MRE
summaries.body: Three diamond tails at Nanadie returned broad copper-gold zones outside the current 40.4 million tonne resource, led by 52m @ 0.71% Cu, 0.13g/t Au from 406m in NANRCD033, including 6m @ 1.79% Cu, 0.37g/t Au. Follow-up DHEM surveying identified a 140m x 140m conductive plate below the hole near a cross-fault, to be tested immediately by an 850m EIS co-funded hole. Three rigs remain active, with assays pending from 16 diamond and over 20 RC holes.

summaries.heading: New high-grade copper hits extend Nyungu Central deposit
summaries.body: Assays from Prospect Resources' Phase 3 programme at Mumbezhi returned 27m @ 0.69% Cu from 102m (NCDD033) and 5.1m @ 0.99% Cu from 173m (NCDD031), both outside the existing 154.4Mt @ 0.42% Cu Nyungu Central resource. The programme has been expanded by a further 3,375m to 13,375m targeting the eastern flank and northern down plunge. Maiden drilling at Sharamba confirmed a new copper discovery, while Kabikupa extensional drilling continues with assays pending.

summaries.heading: Roe Hills maiden Terra Prospect hits deliver high-grade gold
summaries.body: First drill results from the Terra Prospect at Pilbara Gold's Roe Hills Project, 100km east of Kalgoorlie, include 46m @ 3.17g/t Au from 92m incl. 18m @ 4.36g/t Au from 110m (26RHRC001) and 4m @ 9.91g/t Au from 144m incl. 1m @ 33.62g/t Au from 145m (26RHRC006). Mineralisation is traced over 1,500m and remains open north, south and at depth. About 6,300m of drilling remains at Terra and the Caliburn Prospect 3km south.

summaries.heading: Corazon starts maiden RC drilling at Chalice Gold Project
summaries.body: Corazon Mining has commenced a 50-hole, approximately 7,500m RC drill program at its 100%-owned Chalice Gold Project near Higginsville, WA. Drilling targets extensions to the existing 191,000oz at 2.7g/t Au resource, testing continuity up to 1,000m south of the historical open pit and to around 200m vertical depth. The program sits within an Exploration Target of 9.7 to 12.3Mt at 1.9 to 2.1g/t Au (approximately 600,000 to 830,000oz contained gold), and first assays are expected within weeks, with completion due by November 2026.

summaries.heading: Nexus Minerals halted ahead of raising and resource upgrade
summaries.body: Nexus Minerals entered a trading halt pending announcements on a capital raising and an upgraded Mineral Resource Estimate for the Wallbrook Gold Project. Trading remains halted until the capital raising announcement or the start of normal trading on 21 September 2026, whichever comes first.

summaries.heading: New Columbia hole extends stacked gold zones over 140m
summaries.body: Fire assays for DDCO26-003 returned 48m @ 1.13g/t Au from 18.0m across multiple stacked zones, including 6.1m @ 3.50g/t Au from 81.0m (with 1.5m @ 12.1g/t Au) and 100% core recovery through the high-grade zone. DDCO26-004 also hit gold from first sample, 7.0m @ 0.82g/t Au from 12.0m and 5.7m @ 1.34g/t Au from 45.0m, while deep test DDCO26-002 (700.8m) returned no significant gold but added structural data. Fire assays also confirmed the earlier PhotonAssay result of 46.8m @ 5.33g/t Au from 88.2m in DDCO26-001. Assays for holes 5 to 7 are due in October 2026, ahead of an updated Columbia Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for November 2026.

summaries.heading: Taruga finds new high-grade gold-copper trend at Uaroo Ridge
summaries.body: New soil and rock chip sampling has defined a 500m northeast gold-copper trend cross cutting the existing 1km mineralised corridor at Uaroo Ridge, Gascoyne province, WA. Rock chip UARK042 returned 1.4g/t Au and 4.3% Cu, the highest grade recorded at the prospect to date, alongside 0.5g/t Au and 2.6% Cu (UARK043) and 0.4g/t Au and 2.4% Cu (UARK041). Taruga has also relinquished tenement E08/3733 and parts of E08/3245 and E08/3734 to focus on Uaroo Ridge, Thowagee and Moodong Well, with follow-up soil sampling and geophysics planned next.

summaries.heading: Santana added to GDXJ gold miners ETF
summaries.body: Santana Minerals will join the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) at the close of trading on 18 September 2026, following the fund's semi-annual rebalance. The GDXJ holds approximately US$8.9 billion in net assets, giving Santana exposure to index-linked institutional and retail investors as it advances the Bendigo-Ophir Gold Project toward construction.

summaries.heading: Amended Muntanga update adds JORC disclosures, no new data
summaries.body: Atomic Eagle has reissued its Muntanga drilling update solely to add Listing Rule 5.23 and 5.13 disclosures and a Competent Person sign-off following ASX consultation. The company confirms no new information affects the exploration results, which include a 600m by 200m mineralised zone at Muntanga North Target 5 and a 1,000m by 400m zone at Namakande Target 2, both remaining open. Further drilling at Targets 6 to 8 is expected through Q4 2026.

summaries.heading: Legacy Minerals to add scandium to NiCo Young resource
summaries.body: Legacy Minerals has engaged WSP Australia to complete an updated Mineral Resource Estimate at the 100%-owned NiCo Young project in NSW, incorporating scandium alongside the existing 167.8Mt at 0.59% Ni and 0.06% Co Inferred Resource for the first time. A higher-grade component of 42.5Mt at 0.80% Ni and 0.09% Co also sits within the deposit. The combined Ni-Co-Sc estimate is expected in October 2026.

summaries.heading: Enterprise Metals halted pending capital raising and board changes
summaries.body: ENT entered a trading halt at its own request while it considers, plans and executes a capital raising, and advises of proposed board changes. The halt remains until normal trading resumes on Monday, 21 September 2026, or an announcement is made earlier. Details of the raising and board changes are the next catalyst.
